text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan

(Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan) (Objek Warisan) 2016.

Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Objek yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang telah diisytiharkan sebagai

objek warisan dalam Pengisytiharan Objek Warisan 2008 [P.U. (B) 439/2008] yang

disiarkan dalam Warta pada 13 November 2008 dan disenaraikan dalam Daftar

diisytiharkan sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan.

JADUAL

1. Adat Cukur Jambul (Kaum Melayu)

2. Berkhatan/Bersunat Anak-anak Melayu

3. Buka Tanah Baru (Iban Sarawak)

4. Melenggang Perut (Kaum Melayu)

5. Batu Seremban

6. Dam Haji

7. Galah Panjang

8. Ketinting

9. Konda Kondi

10. Sepak Raga Bulatan

11. Bongai

12. Dabus

13. Datun Julud

14. Ghazal

15. Rodat

16. Tarian Topeng Mah Meri (Mayin Jooh)

17. Tarian Ulik Mayang

DATO' SERI MOHAMED NAZRI BIN TAN SRI ABDUL AZIZ

Menteri Pelancongan dan Kebudayaan

Bertarikh 10 Februari 2016

[JWN.PP.600/3/51/1/2; PN(PU2)652/XII]

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE OBJECT) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the

National Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of National

Heritage) (Heritage Object) Order 2016.

National Heritage

2. The objects specified in the Schedule that have been declared as heritage objects in

the Declaration of Heritage Object 2008 [P.U. (B) 439/2008] as published in the Gazette

on 13 November 2008 and listed in the Register are declared to be National Heritage.

SCHEDULE

1. Shave Off Forelock (Malay)

2. Circumcision/Malay Children Circumcision

3. Opening of New Land (Sarawak's Ibans)

4. Stomach Swings (Malay)

5. Batu Seremban

6. Haj Checkers

7. Long Galley

8. Ketinting

9. Konda Kondi

10. Circle of Sepak Raga

11. Bongai

12. Dabus

13. Datun Julud

14. Ghazal

15. Rodat

16. Mah Meri Mask Dance (Mayin Jooh)

17. Ulik Mayang Dance

Dated 10 February 2016

[JWN.PP.600/3/51/1/2; PN(PU2)652/XII]

DATO' SERI MOHAMED NAZRI BIN TAN SRI ABDUL AZIZ

Minister of Tourism and Culture
